Context: IX. Constant Attendant Allowance:

## IX. Constant Attendant Allowance:  
For 100% disability, where the individual is completely dependent on somebody else for day-to-day functions, a Constant Attendant Allowance of ~ 6,750 p.m. shall be allowed in addition to the disability pension subject to conditions. Further, this allowance shall be increased by 25% every time Dearness Allowance on the revised pay in the Pay Matrix increases by 50%.  
- GIDs (11) and (12), Rule 9-A, CCS (EOP) Rules.
